heading: Tuesday, July 21, 2026
topLine: Google releases Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite
items.summary: Gemini 3.6 Flash upgrades 3.5 Flash, and Google says it uses about 17% fewer output tokens and reports 83.0% on OSWorld-Verified. It is priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ($0.30/$2.50) is the fastest 3.5-class model; Google also announced a limited-access 3.5 Flash Cyber model.
